meta.title: About Us | Ha Bac Garment
meta.description: Ha Bac Export Garment JSC, founded 2002 in Bắc Giang Province, ranks among Vietnam's 50 largest garment enterprises and manufactures for Gap, Walmart, Zara, H&M and other global brands.

hero.title: Two Decades of Manufacturing Discipline
hero.subtitle: A Bắc Giang-based, export-focused garment manufacturer built for brands that need consistent quality at scale.

story.title: Founded in 2002, Built for Export
story.p1: Công ty Cổ phần May Xuất khẩu Hà Bắc (Ha Bac Export Garment Joint Stock Company) was established in September 2002 in Bắc Giang Province to serve international apparel brands seeking a stable, compliant production base in Vietnam. The company has grown into a two-plant operation employing over 3,000 management staff and skilled workers.
story.p2: Today we manufacture for major international retailers and fashion brands, with a focus on long-term production partnerships rather than one-off orders. We are ranked among Vietnam's 50 largest garment enterprises and have been recognized as a FAST500 fastest-growing enterprise (2015–2020) and a 2020 Trustworthy Export Enterprise by Vietnam's Ministry of Industry and Trade.
story.p3: Our management team has overseen full-package export production for nearly two decades, building internal systems so customers can audit our facilities with confidence and verify our compliance with international labor and environmental standards.

meta.title: Production Process | Ha Bac Garment
meta.description: A step-by-step view of Ha Bac Export Garment's production process, quality control standards and typical lead times.

hero.title: From Tech Pack to Shipped Container
hero.subtitle: A documented, repeatable process designed to give brand partners visibility at every stage.

steps.step1Desc: Submit your tech pack, target quantity and timeline via our RFQ form. Our merchandising team reviews construction, fabric and trim requirements and follows up with clarifying questions within 24–48 hours.
steps.step2Desc: Proto and fit samples are produced and costed transparently, with line-item breakdowns for fabric, trim, labor and overhead. Typical sample turnaround is 7–10 working days.
steps.step3Desc: Fabric and trims are sourced from our network of approved mills. Lab dips, strike-offs and bulk fabric inspection reports are shared for sign-off before cutting begins.
steps.step4Desc: Pre-production (PP) sample approval, purchase order confirmation, and production scheduling against our line capacity.
steps.step5Desc: Computerized multi-ply cutting followed by modular line sewing, with in-line quality checks at each work station rather than only at the end of the line.
steps.step6Desc: Garment dye and pressing/finishing as required by style, followed by trimming and thread cleaning.
steps.step7Desc: 100% inline inspection plus AQL 2.5 final random inspection. Customer-nominated or third-party inspectors are welcomed for pre-shipment inspection.
steps.step8Desc: Retail-ready folding, polybagging and carton packing per your packing list, with FOB, CIF or DDP shipment booked through Hai Phong port.

qc.title: Inspection Standards
qc.p1: Every order passes through three checkpoints: inline inspection during sewing, end-of-line inspection before finishing, and a final randomized AQL 2.5 inspection prior to packing.
qc.p2: We maintain detailed inspection records per PO and provide inspection reports to customers on request. Customer or third-party inspectors may attend any stage with advance notice.
qc.cp1Text: Defects-per-hundred-units tracked per line, per hour.

leadtimes.title: Typical Lead Times
leadtimes.note: Lead times begin from PP sample approval and confirmed material availability. Repeat programs with held fabric stock can run shorter cycles.

approach.title: Compliance as Operating Practice, Not a Checklist
approach.p1: We treat labor standards, workplace safety and environmental management as core to how the factories run day to day — not preparation exercises ahead of a scheduled audit.
approach.p2: Internal social compliance staff conduct quarterly self-audits at each facility, and corrective action plans from any third-party audit finding are tracked to closure with documented evidence.
